title: Outdoor Smoked Slovakian Pork Wrap
description: A sweet and juicy solo dinner dish featuring smoked pork, this Slovakian inspired meal is perfect for a weeknight dinner, the pork is slow cooked to perfection and wrapped in a paleo friendly ssam wrap
instructions: Preheat the smoker to 225 degrees Fahrenheit
In a small bowl, mix together the smoke paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper
Rub the spice mixture all over the pork shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly
Place the pork shoulder in the smoker and close the lid
Smoke the pork for 8 hours, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 190 degrees Fahrenheit
After 8 hours, remove the pork from the smoker and let it rest for 10 minutes
Slice the pork into thin strips
In a small bowl, whisk together the apple cider vinegar and honey
Brush the vinegar and honey mixture onto the pork strips
Warm the ssam wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds
Assemble the wraps by placing a few slices of the pork onto the center of each wrap
